description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProductPurchased' within the OpenCart admin extension framework. The class provides methods to retrieve purchased product data and total counts from the database, including filtering by order status and date range.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: A model class for retrieving purchased product data and statistics, including filtering by order status and date range.

methods.name: getPurchased
methods.description: Retrieves a list of purchased products with total quantity and total revenue, applying optional filters for order status and date range.

methods.name: getTotalPurchased
methods.description: Returns the total number of distinct purchased products, with optional filtering for order status and date range.
